test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

A sudden noise frightened the horse.

options.text: The horse has been frightened by a sudden noise.
The horse was frightened by a sudden noise.
The horse had frightened by a sudden noise.
The horse got frightened by a sudden noise.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The horse was frightened by a sudden noise.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **active **voice, **the subject performs the action on the object**. In this case, the sudden noise is causing the horse to be frightened.
 
• **Active Voice Structure**: Subject + Verb + Object__
 __
 
• **Example**: *The chef cooked a delicious meal.*
 
 
 
• In the **passive** voice, the focus shifts from the doer of the action (**sudden noise**) to the recipient of the action (**the horse**). 
 
• The agent (**sudden noise**) that performs the action is introduced with the preposition "**by**."
 
• **Passive Voice Structure**: Object + was + V3 + By + Agent__
 
 
• **Example**: *A delicious meal was cooked by the chef.*
 
 

*​*Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
